newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active at $118/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active at $118/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active, USDA said. Steers and heifers were steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 117.00- 118.00. ( weighted average 117.62 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 117.00- 118.00 (weighted average 117.35).
Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 higher on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand moderate, seller interest fairly strong in light of lower closes on the CME Futures Market.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 73.00-74.00, delivered. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 73.00-73.50, delivered.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $1.00-$2.00 higher, dressed basis fully $2.00 higher. Weekly total includes 4,100 formulated and previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 4,200 Last Week - 1,600 Last Year - 35,700 Wk To Date- 66,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 58,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 66,400
